articles.deck: Supporters and opponents on Elm Avenue disagreed about cost and timing.
body: Public works estimates the work will take about 17 weeks once it starts in December. Residents of Canal Park said they had been asking for action for years, and several brought photographs of the street.

The ordinance will return to the agenda at the next regular session, unless the chair calls a special meeting first. Councilmember Felix Chandler asked for more time to review the proposal, which would cost about $18,500.
Staff recommended approval with two conditions: a traffic study and a public notice period of 30 days.

articles.title: Letter: The Playground Upgrade on Eaton Court Needs Attention
body: To the editor: I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the August meeting. To the editor: I have lived on Eaton Court for 9 years, and I want to say what a difference the Stonebridge Trail Crew has made.
Please keep the playground upgrade in the budget. Many of us on Eaton Court use it every week.
